title: Reuse initial task context when discovering additional files
context: Previous guidance described prompt-hook context as satisfying context for one file, leaving ambiguity about whether discovering another file required another brief. Touches invariant(s): con_8460b6770f (Config/provider writers must merge idempotently into existing user files and refuse to clobber an unparseable file); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Treat a task-linked prompt-hook brief as satisfying the task's initial context step. Request further context only for missing information or risk, and check constraints before editing scope the brief does not cover.
consequences: Discovering another file alone does not require another hunch_context call.
File-specific coverage remains explicit; uncovered edits still require hunch_check_constraints.
Hook text, generated repository guidance, MCP instructions, and tests reflect the same rule.
alternatives_rejected: Require another context brief solely because an additional file is discovered.

rejected_tripwires.alternative: Require another context brief solely because an additional file is discovered.
